canonical_project: Beetaloo Digital Weddell AI Data Centre & Energy Mega-Campus
owner: Beetaloo Digital Pty Ltd (Beetaloo Energy subsidiary)
notes: Beetaloo Digital was granted a 12-month exclusive commitment by the NT Government over a 185-hectare site at Weddell (Litchfield LGA, ~30km SE of Darwin) to develop a claimed ~A$40bn, ~2GW AI data centre and energy mega-campus powered by gas from the Beetaloo Basin (two gas-fired power stations proposed). Status = announced/early (land exclusivity, feasibility and regulatory approvals pending); 2GW is the proponent's ultimate campus claim, not built capacity. Official NT Government Territory Coordinator page (5 Aug 2026) confirms the land commitment.
